description: Three-phase DIN rail energy meters of the EQ A-series (A41 direct connected, A42 CT/VT connected), Modbus RTU over RS485
source: ABB, "A41/A42 User Manual", 2CMC484002M0201 revision D (2025-11-07); https://library.abb.com/d/2CMC484002M0201
notes: ABB EQ meters A41 (direct, 80 A) and A42 (CT/VT connected) with RS485, protocol set to Modbus.
Addresses are exactly as sent on the bus. Readable range is 0x1000-0x8EFF; any block of 1-125 registers works.
Quantities a model does not have read as "invalid": all FFFF for unsigned, the largest positive value for signed.
Harmonics read as not available right after start-up and while the frequency measurement is disturbed.
Inputs, outputs, tariffs, CO2 and currency depend on the variant (Steel, Bronze, Silver, Gold).
Historical data (load profile, logs, demand, previous values) uses a request/response scheme and is not in this map.
The manual does not state the factory RS485 settings; check them on the meter display.

registers.name: CO2 for active import
registers.description: Uses the CO2 conversion factor at 0x8CE0

registers.name: Currency for active import
registers.description: Uses the currency conversion factor at 0x8CE2

registers.name: Resettable reactive energy import
registers.description: The manual's table gives kWh; kvarh assumed

registers.name: Resettable reactive energy export
registers.description: The manual's table gives kWh; kvarh assumed

registers.name: Total active power
registers.description: Limited to about ±21 MW; use the DMTME block above that

registers.name: DMTME total active power
registers.description: No decimals; for powers above ±21 MW

registers.name: DMTME CT ratio
registers.description: 1-999999; valid when the CT secondary is set to 1

registers.name: DMTME VT ratio
registers.description: 1-9999; valid when the VT secondary is set to 1

registers.name: Clock year
registers.description: Year byte of the date/time; the date/time is written as one 3-register value, not field by field

registers.name: Last power outage hours
registers.description: Duration of the last outage; its days (3 bytes from 0x8A39) are not in this map

registers.name: Reset count active energy import
registers.description: Times the resettable register was reset

registers.name: DST start month
registers.description: Start and end are each written as one 2-register value
